stopConditions: owner authorization does not identify exactly one Cloudflare account ID and the exact reviewed packet digest
the authenticated Cloudflare account does not match the owner-authorized account ID
a D1 database named 8978-ai-authority-dev already exists
the operator cannot prove wrangler.jsonc and deployment/development-activation-plan.json remain unchanged
the requested operation would create or update a binding, Worker, Workflow, consumer, producer, route, secret, migration, schema, or record
any create or verification response is ambiguous, incomplete, or inconsistent with this packet
requiredEvidence: reviewed repository commit and packet SHA-256 digest
authenticated operator identity without credential material
D1 database name and immutable database ID
D1 location and jurisdiction metadata returned by Cloudflare
proof the D1 database is empty and unbound without executing SQL
Queue name and immutable queue ID
proof the Queue has no producers or consumers and received no messages
proof no Workflow or Worker deployment was created or changed
exact errors and final remote state if execution stops partially complete
